description: The EChart Visual combines power of ECharts and Handlebars.js with Power BI data to build about 20 chart types within Power BI like Deneb or Plotly.js visuals. The visual initializes container and prepares data for the visual. Authors have to specify options for the chart. The visual creates ECharts dataset from data provided for the visual by Power BI. Or user can use Power of Handlebars.js expressions to bind data directly data properties of ECharts option.
